parts.text: $O Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.6B, +10% Y/Y, with an operating margin of 28.1% as property investments and steady leasing activity supported results. #earnings #REITs

$CWH Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.6B, -12% Y/Y amid continued pressure on new vehicle margins. Operating margin -17.3% as the company accelerated cost-reduction initiatives to realign its cost base. #earnings #retail
$CC Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.5B, +3% Y/Y, driven by pricing execution in Titanium Technologies and APM growth. Operating margin 14.4%. #earnings #materials
$ROKU Q3 2026: revenue $1.5B, up 24% Y/Y, driven by advertising growth and higher streaming engagement. Operating margin reached 10.9% as operating expenses declined. #earnings #media
$FN Q1 FY27 (preliminary): revenue $1.5B, +51% Y/Y, driven by broad-based demand across multiple programs and new product ramps. Operating margin 9.9%. #earnings #tech

$CRGY Q3 2026: revenue $1.4B, +56% Y/Y, driven by oil growth which rose 75% and made up 77% of total revenue. Operating margin reached 35.4%, while operating cash flow was $608M. Net loss was $591K due to interest and other expenses. #earnings #oil
$HLF Q3 2026: revenue $1.4B, +6% Y/Y, driven by an 8.6% increase in sales volume and favorable pricing actions. Operating margin 10.3%; operating cash flow $151M. #earnings #healthcare
$VVX Q3 2026: revenue $1.3B, +9% Y/Y, driven by aerospace and modernization programs and national security support. Operating margin 4.7%; operating cash flow $67M. #earnings #industrials
$JAZZ Q3 2026: revenue $1.2B, +10% Y/Y, driven by sleep disorders and oncology portfolios. Operating margin -33.3% due to elevated operating costs; operating cash flow $506M. #earnings #pharma

$NBIX Q3 2026: revenue $1.1B, +41% Y/Y, driven by increased net product sales of INGREZZA and CRENESSITY, plus the inclusion of VYKAT XR following the Soleno acquisition. Operating margin 29.5%; operating cash flow $395M. #earnings #biotech

$BMRN Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $1.0B, +32% Y/Y, driven by a 44% increase in metabolic conditions following the Amicus acquisition. Operating margin -8.0%; operating cash flow $188M. #earnings #pharma

$CBT Q4 FY26 (preliminary): revenue $1.0B, +12% Y/Y, driven by solid performance in Performance Chemicals despite lower gross profit in Reinforcement Materials. Operating margin 12.0%. #earnings #materials
